kauth.cause: Malformed helper-install-dir-cache.patch: the hunk header declared 7 lines but the patch ended after 6, so dpkg-source rejected it before sbuild.
dpkg-gensymbols rejected two non-optional RTTI/vtable symbols for implementation-private AuthBackend::Private; two other missing templinst symbols were already optional and not causal.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: Tier 2 discovery validator still hardcoded KAuth package_version_candidate 6.30.0-0supralinux1 after the campaign advanced to revision -3.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Require package_version_candidate to equal the current packaging.package_version instead of hardcoding a revision.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: KAuth revision -3 was queued but never entered retained-input download or Build and validate before the validator-fix push superseded the PR run.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Scope selector now keeps any prepared/remediation package revision runnable until that exact revision has package_attempted=true in the real-attempt ledger.
